# R_LIT

- purpose: Collection of independent Rust CLI tools, companion desktop tools, and shared crates built for medium- and long-term maintenance
- scope: All CLI binaries standardize on `crates/rlit_cli` (`--json`, `__schema`, exit codes, `runlog`); desktop/GUI tools (`deskpet`, `maquette`, `group_vibe_workbench`, `mpreview`) coexist in the same repo
- repository: https://github.com/dwbmio/r_lit
- install_base: https://r2.gamesci-lite.com/r_lit/<tool>/install.sh
- release_tracker: https://hfrog.gamesci-lite.com/api/release/softwares/<tool>

- release_scope: install_base/release_tracker apply only to published tools; artifact-inspect is built from source, with local macOS arm64 and Jenkins pilot Linux x86_64 validation; no registered release or installer claimed
- artifact_inspect_routes: root .justfile generic build/install_loc can route to the crate; fixed test-cli/lint-cli omit it; generic routing is not CI toolMap/HFrog registration
- artifact_inspect_contract: hierarchical containers[].files[] JSON, HTML metadata/text/image previews, one artifact-inspect.log; name/path suppression is not a secret scan or confidentiality guarantee; sizes are not network transfer estimates

## Directory

- archcast/ — AI-first deterministic architecture & flow report compiler (SIMD + Rayon + optional WebGPU; YAML <-> 1:1 HTML+SVG with minimal-bounds WebGPU/Canvas2D motion, standalone SVG, PNG/layered GIF, Markdown+Mermaid); docs: archcast/README.md, archcast/llms.txt, archcast/SKILL.md
- artifact-inspect/ — Offline build inventories (directory/ZIP/TAR.GZ/TGZ), per-layer JSON and HTML metadata/image previews; docs: artifact-inspect/README.md, artifact-inspect/llms.txt
- audiogen/ — Pure-Rust game audio pipeline (procedural SFX, MP3/WAV/FLAC encoding, async MiniMax jobs)
- bulk_upload/ — Batch extract URLs from JSON, upload to S3-compatible storage
- deskpet/ — Frameless transparent always-on-top 3D/Spine desktop mascot (Bevy + tray / menu-bar resident)
- distill/ — Pure-Rust cross-functional knowledge distillation & P2P Q&A suite (dual binaries: `distilld` + `distill` CLI/MCP over `iroh` QUIC; bare Git + LRU worktrees + AEAD blob cache + BLAKE3 DLP gate; zero raw source exposure)
- gamereel/ — Render game protocol replays into short videos (Cargo workspace; CUDA + FFmpeg)
- group_vibe_workbench/ — Desktop collaboration workbench (GPUI + Murmur P2P)
- img_resize/ — Image resizing and compression
- looplog/ — Local log intake/query tool for AI-assisted debugging (guide: looplog/WECHAT_AI_DEBUG_CN.md)
- mailctl/ — Multi-mailbox IMAP/SMTP dispatcher (per-mailbox identity, allowlist, confirm-before-send, audit; `mailctl capabilities --json`)
- maquette/ — Kit-based low-poly modeling + glTF export (GUI + headless CLI)
- mini_reg/ — Native Rust mini-app registration helper; persistent batches; verified enterprise Chrome; human confirmations
- mj_atlas/ — Sprite atlas / packing tool with incremental builds and polygon meshes
- mpreview/ — Godot model preview and multi-angle camera screenshot tool
- phone_haul/ — Phone media migration (Android adb+agent + iOS AFC/Photos.sqlite, BLAKE3 dedup, yyyy/MM archive)
- textexture/ — Art-text image generation (shadow / stroke / gradient / glow / neon)
- ui-trim/ — Clean AI-generated UI asset PNGs into tight transparent PNGs
- crates/murmur/ — P2P collaboration library (iroh-net + Automerge CRDT)
- crates/rlit_cli/ — Shared CLI machine-call contract (`--json` envelope, `__schema`, exit codes, `runlog`)

## Machine Call Contract

- spec: docs/cli-contract.md; shared crate: crates/rlit_cli
- adopted_by: archcast, artifact-inspect, mj_atlas, img_resize, ui-trim, textexture, bulk_upload, audiogen, phone_haul, mini_reg, looplog, mailctl, maquette-cli
- json: `--json` -> exactly one envelope {contract, ok, tool, version, command, data, artifacts, error} on stdout
- exit_codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 input, 4 external, 5 partial
- schema: `<tool> __schema` -> JSON Schema per subcommand + x-cli / x-effects / x-env / x-stdin
- runlog: `rlit_cli::runlog` provides dual-sink buffered logging flushed to `<output>.log`

## Build

```bash
cd <tool_dir> && cargo build --release
```

- binary_layout: target/ is disposable; retained local executables use <tool>/out/<target-triple>/<binary>; Jenkins publishes release artifacts to R2/HFrog
- repo_checks: `python3 scripts/check_repo.py` or `just check`

## AI Debug Loop Context

- related_tooling: bbc-ai-skill; https://git.7k7k.com/starlink/bbc-ai-skills; https://github.com/dwbmio/gamesci-cc-plugins
- repeated_log_debugging: prefer looplog/ for local AI-assisted log review, fix-and-rerun loops, skill/plugin debugging, and WeChat Mini Program debugging
- looplog_ai_query_path: looplog list --json; looplog grep <pattern> --json; looplog show <run_id> --json

See each subdirectory's README and llms.txt for details.
